source_instruction: i am looking for a women's socks made up of polyester cotton which is washable in machine. also choose black or semi mint rush green color.
query: I stopped by the community garden on my walk over this morning, and the raised bed I planted with sunflower seeds back in late spring finally has tiny fuzzy buds peeking out just below the top of the stems, all bright and tender green against the dark crumbly soil. The older retired guy who tends the tomato plot two beds over gave me a handful of the sweetest cherry tomatoes I’ve tasted all year, warm straight from the vine and so juicy they dripped down my wrist when I bit into one, and he told me the secret to his crop is sprinkling crushed eggshells around the base of each plant to keep slugs away. A tiny calico kitten that’s been hanging around the garden plots lately curled up on my scuffed sneakers while I was chatting with him, purring so loud I could feel the vibration through the canvas, and it kept batting at the loose end of my hoodie string like it was the most fascinating toy in the whole world. I’ve heard women’s socks and hosiery made of a polyester cotton blend that are safe for dishwasher wash, available in either black, semi turbo pink, or semi mint rush green, fit the exact set of preferences I hold for this kind of item. I’ve also heard these pieces come at a reasonable cost that lines up with not wanting to spend too much on them.
